newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Halla Engineering in j/v with Sofregaz.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Halla Engineering in j/v with Sofregaz.

text.p: Halla Engineering and Heavy Industries Ltd, a unit of South Korea's Halla Group, said on Thursday it had entered into a engineering joint venture with France's Sofregaz.

The venture, Halla-Sofregaz Gas Engineering, will treat natural gas and construct liquefied gas facilities, Halla said in a statement. It did not say how much either group would invest in the new company.
Halla will take a 51 percent stake and Sofregaz, a unit of France's state-owned Gaz de France, will have 49 percent of the venture, the statement said.
"The demand for liquefied natural gas in Korea has grown rapidly during the past 10 years as a result of the country's economic growth and rising popular concern about the environment," Halla said.
It said the new venture was signed in Paris on Wednesday.
